name: COMPETITION
description: pointer to the competition database record (its +0 is the competition id); Comp base field
evidence: same Comp base offset as league::COMPETITION (verified); the cup constructors write their record argument there and cup routines read [this+4] then [..+0] as the comp id

name: COMP_STATS
description: pointer to the competition's Comp_Stats object, 0 = none; Comp base field
evidence: same Comp base offset as league::COMP_STATS (verified); the cup constructors store Comp_Stats::Comp_Stats (0x49ee70) there and pass [this+8] to Comp_Stats::set_club_final_position

name: QUALIFIED_CLUBS
description: pointer to the 32-place list of qualified clubs (4 bytes each): 0..15 east zone, 16..31 west zone; places 0/16 for the holder
evidence: AsiaCupWinner::select_qualified_clubs 0x40d830 callocs 32 x 4 there and fills it; create_zone_stage 0x40ddf0 reads entries 16.. as the west zone stage teams

name: QUALIFIED_CLUB_COUNT
evidence: AsiaCupWinner::select_qualified_clubs 0x40d830 writes 0x20 there before allocating the list
